title: Battle of Round Mountain
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Round Mountain", at revision 1376379973, opens: "The Battle of Round Mountain was the first battle in the Trail of Blood on Ice campaign for the control of Indian Territory during the American Civil War that occurred on November 19, 1861. Its main purpose was to prevent Union supporters of the Creek Nation, led by Opothleyahola from fleeing Indian Territory to the protection of Union forces in Kansas." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1387925, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1861 battle of the American Civil War in Oklahoma". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
